mapper.update: UPDATE biz.inbound_mapping SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE eqp_pallet_id = #{eqpPalletId}
UPDATE biz.inbound_mapping SET wcs_task_id = #{wcsTaskId}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE eqp_pallet_id = #{eqpPalletId}
